implement.name: Children reach the parent through context
implement.summary: A compound child reads parent state through context (or its framework equivalent), never through a prop chain of three or more

implement.name: Sub-components are co-located with the parent
implement.summary: A compound's parts travel with the parent — `<Tabs>` carries `<Tab>`, a separate path exports neither

implement.name: A compound is consumed as one symbol
implement.summary: The library exposes the parent; a consumer who reaches for `<Tab items={…}>` is reading the wrong shape
